2607.05769.title: LEGATO 2: Toward Multimodal Sheet Music Recognition and Understanding
2607.05769.paper_summary: We propose a novel pipeline, Legato 2, for extracting symbolic notation and semantic knowledge from images of sheet music. Legato 2 features the first large-scale neural model for optical music recognition (OMR) to operate sequentially on a system-by-system basis, following the horizontal lines of notation as they are read on the page, rather than treating the page as an undifferentiated image, enabling better scaling to arbitrarily long inputs. It is also the first OMR model capable of generating symbolic transcriptions that include embedded textual content, such as titles and annotations. The pipeline combines system-level segmentation with an autoregressive vision-LM to capture both local notation details and score structure. Across multiple datasets, Legato 2 consistently outperforms prior state of the art. We also show that symbolic transcriptions complement visual inputs for frontier language models, improving their interpretation of dense musical documents. Legato 2 establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both OMR and downstream sheet music understanding.
2607.05769.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個新穎的流程，Legato 2，用於從樂譜圖像中提取符號標記和語義知識。Legato 2 具有首個大規模的神經模型，用於光學音樂識別（OMR），能夠依據系統逐一運作，沿著樂譜的水平線條進行閱讀，而不是將頁面視為一幅未經區分的圖像，這使其能更好地擴展到任意長度的輸入。它也是第一個能夠生成包含嵌入文本內容的符號轉錄的 OMR 模型，例如標題和註釋。該流程結合了系統級別的分割與自回歸視覺-LM，以捕捉局部標記細節和樂譜結構。在多個數據集上，Legato 2 一直超越先前的最先進技術。我們還展示了符號轉錄如何補充前沿語言模型的視覺輸入，改善它們對密集音樂文件的解釋。Legato 2 在 OMR 和下游樂譜理解方面建立了新的最先進性能。
